value.rationale: Deleting a perfect matching from K_{n,n} is a canonical structural perturbation, and the theorem determines exactly how every strong defensive alliance responds. The matched-index overlap criterion yields a parity-sensitive minimum transition and a full all-cardinality polynomial. This is a motivated exact classification of an infinite graph family, not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere recomputation of the known complete-bipartite value.
